title: Coca-Cola | Uncanned Emotions - FIFA World Cup 2026™

segments.description: Over-the-shoulder medium shot of a football commentator watching a match on a tablet inside a stadium broadcast booth.
Close-up shot of hands holding and twisting open a chilled glass bottle of Coca-Cola in dim lighting.
Close-up shot of a person popping open the tab of a cold Coca-Cola can covered in condensation.
Close-up shot of hands gripping a red Coca-Cola can tightly as tension builds during the football match.
Macro extreme close-up of goosebumps rising on a person's arm in response to the intense game moment.
Dynamic macro shot of a single cola droplet falling into a glass, creating rippling concentric circles.
Extreme close-up macro shot of a human eye dilating with excitement and emotion.
Medium action shot of fans cheering wildly in a pub as a Coca-Cola bottle sprays and fizzes excitedly.
Close-up shot of diverse fans laughing and celebrating together outdoors with Coca-Cola cans in hand.
Close-up shot of a person's eye welling up with tears of joy while watching the match.
Medium shot of a woman taking a refreshing drink from a glass Coca-Cola bottle by the sea, ending with the official FIFA World Cup partnership logo.
